snippet.title: Zelda II: The Adventure of Mario Trailer (F3 2026) (Extended Cut)
snippet.description:
An amazing romhack by Jroweboy! 

Mario sets out on his most adventuresome journey yet! Explore the land of Hyrule using 100% authentic Mario 1 physics and movement. Traverse the vast overworld, defeating dangerous Iron Knuckles and other familiar Zelda 2 enemies using the spells and tricks that Mario will find along the way. It's Mario 1 in Zelda 2. What else would you expect?

Will Mario save the princess as he always does?
